question: How far BEYOND the swing extreme is the stop placed -- what is the exact buffer distance (ticks, points, ATR multiple, or exactly at the wick tip)?
whyItMatters: CLAIM|TJR|20260727|028 states direction and anchor ('underneath the low' / 'above the highs') but never a distance. 'Beyond' is directional, not metric. This single missing number determines stop distance, therefore position size under any fixed-fractional risk model, therefore realised risk-to-reward, therefore every performance figure the strategy would be judged on. The stop rule cannot be executed or backtested until it is answered, and a default of zero (stop exactly at the wick) would be a guess, not a reading of the evidence.
